stem: Ayesha buys 6 notebooks of the same price and one pen at a shop in Karachi. The pen costs 45 rupees, and she pays 375 rupees in total. What is the price, in rupees, of one notebook?
solution: Let \(n\) be the price of one notebook: \(6n + 45 = 375\).
verify:
n = symbols('n')
s = solve(Eq(6*n + 45, 375), n)
assert s == [55]
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == s[0] and len(spr_answers) == 1
